articles.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
articles.summary: Somalia's government continues its struggle against Al-Shabaab. Neither side has achieved a clear victory. Mogadishu must strengthen its military and address civilian hardship in insurgent-held regions. The government is also exploring opportunities for dialogue with the militant group. The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.

articles.title: NATO in Türkiye/Türkiye in NATO
articles.summary: Galip Dalay discussed Türkiye's relationship with NATO and the EU. He spoke with Olga on War & Peace. Ankara is preparing to host the upcoming NATO summit in July. The conversation covered Türkiye's evolving role within the alliance. This week on War & Peace, Olga speaks with Galip Dalay, senior research fellow at Chatham House, about Türkiye’s evolving relations within NATO and with the EU as Ankara prepares to host the upcoming NATO summit in July.

articles.title: Will “El Tigre” Colombia’s New President Launch Another War on Drugs?
articles.summary: Richard spoke with Crisis Group experts Renata Segura and Elizabeth Dickinson. They discussed Colombia's election and president-elect Abelardo “El Tigre” de la Espriella's promises. The conversation also covered outgoing President Gustavo Petro’s "Total Peace" policy. This week on Hold Your Fire!, Richard speaks with Crisis Group experts Renata Segura and Elizabeth Dickinson about Colombia’s turbulent election, president-elect Abelardo “El Tigre” de la Espriella’s hardline promises to fight armed groups and the legacy of outgoing President Gustavo Petro’s signature policy of “Total Peace”.

articles.title: On Our Radar
articles.summary: highlights global conflicts and crises. Crisis Group analysts are monitoring several hotspots. Field experts explain significant trends and potential actions. The segment covers under-reported issues and major developments. Whether an under-reported trend or a headline-grabbing development, our field experts explain why it matters or what should be done.

articles.title: Trump-Zelenskyy Meeting Set For NATO Summit Amid US Push To End Russia's War
articles.summary: President Trump will meet President Zelenskyy at the NATO summit in Ankara. The White House announced the meeting on July 5. The U. S. is pushing for renewed diplomacy on Russia's war. Allies are urged to increase defense responsibilities. US President Donald Trump will meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the sidelines of this week's NATO summit in Ankara, the White House announced on July 5, as Washington seeks to revive stalled diplomacy over Russia's war while pressing European allies to take greater responsibility for the continent's defense.

articles.title: Three sons of Iran's slain leader appear at funeral, not his successor
articles.summary: Mostafa, Meysam, and Masoud Khamenei, sons of Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, attended his funeral. State TV showed Mostafa, Meysam and Masoud Khamenei praying behind the coffins laid out in the vast courtyard of Tehran's Imam Khomeini Grand Mosalla, a sprawling religious complex, but not Mojtaba, who took over as leader.

articles.summary: NATO leaders prepare for a July 7-8 summit in Ankara. articles.title: होर्मुज से गुजरने वाले जहाजों से टोल वसूलेगा ईरान, तेहरान ने किया कंफर्म, भारत से भी लेगा टैक्स?
articles.summary: ईरान होर्मुज स्ट्रेट से गुजरने वाले जहाजों पर सर्विस फीस लगाएगा, भारत समेत अन्य देशों से भी टोल वसूलेगा। ईरान ने दुनिया के सबसे अहम समुद्री व्यापार मार्गों में शामिल होर्मुज स्ट्रेट से गुजरने वाले जहाजों पर सर्विस फीस लगाने की तैयारी शुरू कर दी है. चीन में ईरान के राजदूत अब्दोलरेजा रहमानी फजली ने कहा कि तेहरान जल्द ही नई व्यवस्था लागू करेगा.
